response.justification: Bogdan possesses over 15 years of robust software engineering experience and entrepreneurial background, successfully fulfilling the minimum tenure and degree requirements. However, this role demands a Director-level AI strategist with recognized, deep expertise in AI/ML platforms and extensive experience advising enterprise customers. Bogdan's background aligns much more closely with a hands-on Staff/Senior Full-Stack Engineer, and his AI experience is limited to recent infrastructure tooling rather than high-level AI cloud strategy.
strengths: Over 15 years of diverse software engineering experience across web, mobile, and infrastructure systems.
Demonstrated entrepreneurial and startup experience as the founder of GISCollective.
Proven track record of inspiring and educating others through public talks, workshops, and open-source contributions.
concerns: Lacks recognized, deep expertise in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning strategy.
No evidence of operating at a Director-level individual contributor capacity or driving enterprise-level cloud strategies.
Limited experience advising strategic enterprise customers and partners on cutting-edge AI adoption.
